name: The annotated work desk
reader_question: Why does useful output depend on context and review?
visual_idea: Large source, intent and output fragments occupy one authored desk; a return annotation makes reuse a separate question.
why_geometry_helps: Large source, intent and output fragments occupy one authored desk; a return annotation makes reuse a separate question.
interaction_if_any: Native labelled controls expose the relevant object or consequence; no hover dependency.
false_inference_risk: Overlapping papers could hide the actual sequence; printed annotations state framing, contribution and separate reuse.
